entities.summary: Carlo Ratti is an Italian architect, engineer, inventor and author. He is a professor of the practice at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology where he directs the MIT Senseable City Lab. Ratti is also a founding partner of CRA-Carlo Ratti Associati, an international design and innovation firm with locations in Turin, New York and London.
